quests.name: Short on Copper Ore
quests.summary: The banker of Velneir has run out of copper ore.
intro: My stores are bare. I need 6 copper ore and nobody in Velneir has any to spare.
Bring them to me, however you come by them.
outro: That will keep me going for a good while. Take this for your trouble.

quests.name: A Parcel for the Staff Shop Keeper
quests.summary: Carry a parcel across Velneir to the staff shop keeper.
intro: This should have gone to the staff shop keeper days ago and I cannot leave my post.
Take it over for me and come back when it is done.
outro: Delivered and settled? Good. Here is something for the legwork.

lines: player: A delivery from the general store keeper.
At last. I had begun to think it lost. Tell them the account is settled.

quests.name: Word to the Banker
quests.summary: Call on the banker of Velneir and bring back their answer.
intro: I need an answer from the banker and I would rather not shout it across the street.
Call on them as a customer, then ask how our accounts stand.
outro: Balanced? Then I can sleep tonight. My thanks.

lines: player: The barber sent me to ask after the ledgers.
Tell them the figures balance, for once. There is nothing owed between us this season.

quests.name: Eyes on the Velneir Sewers
quests.summary: Climb down into Velneir Sewers and report what you see.
intro: Something has been scratching under the streets at night. It comes from Velneir Sewers.
Go down the entrance, take a look around and come back in one piece.
outro: So it is as bad as I feared. Thank you for looking, that took nerve.

quests.name: Trouble with Spiders
quests.summary: The archery shop keeper wants the spider near Velneir thinned out.
intro: The spider beyond the walls grow bolder every week. Customers will not walk the road.
Put down 5 of them close to Velneir and I will make it worth your while.
outro: The road is quieter already. Here, as promised.

quests.name: Short on Bones
quests.summary: The magic shop keeper of Velneir has run out of bones.
intro: My stores are bare. I need 6 bones and nobody in Velneir has any to spare.
Bring them to me, however you come by them.
outro: That will keep me going for a good while. Take this for your trouble.

quests.name: A Parcel for the Food Shop Keeper
quests.summary: Carry a parcel across Velneir to the food shop keeper.
intro: This should have gone to the food shop keeper days ago and I cannot leave my post.
Take it over for me and come back when it is done.
outro: Delivered and settled? Good. Here is something for the legwork.

lines: player: A delivery from the clothes shop keeper.
At last. I had begun to think it lost. Tell them the account is settled.

quests.name: Supply Run to Lorowick
quests.summary: Gather copper ore for the banker, then carry a shipment to Lorowick.
intro: I have an order from Lorowick and nothing to fill it with.
Bring me 6 copper ore, then take the packed shipment to the banker there and do some business while you are in town.
outro: They took the lot? Then we have a trade route. Your share, as agreed.

lines: player: Goods from the banker in Velneir.
From Velneir? Then the roads are open after all. Set it down there.

quests.name: The Long Hunt
quests.summary: Hunt the creatures around Velneir and bring back tin ore.
intro: The wilds around Velneir need a firm hand. Start with 5 giant rat outside the walls, then 8 rogue down in Velneir Sewers.
When that is done, bring me 6 tin ore to show for it.
outro: A proper hunt. The town will eat and sleep easier for it.

quests.name: Votes for the Council
quests.summary: Gather support around Velneir for the barber.
intro: The council meets soon and I am short of friends.
Speak to the clothes shop keeper, carry whatever they give you, and see that the paperwork is lodged.
outro: Agreed, all of them? You have a talent for this. Here.

lines: player: The barber asks whether you will stand with them at the next council.
I will, if the fishing shop keeper does. Take this sealed note over and we shall see.
player: A sealed note, from the clothes shop keeper.
Hm. They want my vote. Very well, tell your employer it is agreed.

quests.name: Sweeping the Velneir Sewers
quests.summary: Clear giant spider out of Velneir Sewers and tell the realtor.
intro: Velneir Sewers is crawling with giant spider, and they come up through the drains.
Go down, kill 8 of them, then let the realtor know their cellar is safe.
outro: Both done? Velneir owes you more than I can pay, but take this.

lines: player: Velneir Sewers is clearer than it was. 8 giant spider fewer.
Then the cellars on this street are safe a while longer. I will tell the others.

quests.name: Supply Run to Lorowick (Archery Shop Keeper)
quests.summary: Gather logs for the archery shop keeper, then carry a shipment to Lorowick.
intro: I have an order from Lorowick and nothing to fill it with.
Bring me 8 logs, then take the packed shipment to the archery shop keeper there and do some business while you are in town.
outro: They took the lot? Then we have a trade route. Your share, as agreed.

lines: player: Goods from the archery shop keeper in Velneir.
From Velneir? Then the roads are open after all. Set it down there.

quests.name: The Long Hunt (Magic Shop Keeper)
quests.summary: Hunt the creatures around Velneir and bring back bones.
intro: The wilds around Velneir need a firm hand. Start with 5 spider outside the walls, then 8 giant rat down in Velneir Sewers.
When that is done, bring me 6 bones to show for it.
outro: A proper hunt. The town will eat and sleep easier for it.

quests.name: The Velneir Trade Route
quests.summary: Open a trade route between Velneir and Lorowick.
intro: I mean to open a trade route to Lorowick. It needs a contract carried, a road made safe and a courier who is proven underground.
Deliver the contract, trade there, cut down 12 giant rat near our walls and prove yourself in the dungeoneering caves.
Then have the banker underwrite the venture.
outro: Signed, safe and funded. You have changed the fortunes of this town.
Here is your cut of the first season.

lines: player: A contract from the general store keeper in Velneir.
A fair offer. But the road between us is not safe, and you know it.
player: The route to Lorowick is open and the contract is signed.
Then I will underwrite it. Velneir has not had news this good in years.

quests.name: The Thing Beneath Velneir
quests.summary: Find what rules Velneir Sewers, weaken its nest and destroy The Ooze Mother.
intro: Something rules Velneir Sewers and it is getting stronger. I want it gone.
Ask the banker what they have heard, see it for yourself, then come back and we will decide how to break the nest.
When it is weak, kill it and tell the banker.
outro: I felt the ground go still. Velneir is yours to walk freely, friend.
Take this. It is everything I promised and a little more.

lines: player: Have you heard anything from below the streets?
Every night. Something large is down there, and the small ones answer to it. They call it The Ooze Mother.
So you have seen it. We can thin them by force, or I can have the guard hold the drains if they are supplied.
steps.prompt: How will you weaken the nest?

options.text: I will cut them down myself.
Supply the guard and let them hold the drains.

lines: player: The Ooze Mother is dead. Velneir Sewers is quiet.
Then the vaults are safe and so is everyone above them. The town will hear of this.

quests.name: The Fall of the Broodmother
quests.summary: March on Frostbite Cavern, break its creatures and bring down The Broodmother.
intro: Frostbite Cavern has stood against Velneir for too long. The Broodmother sits at the bottom of it.
Learn what you can from the magic shop keeper, fight your way through 12 giant bat and end The Broodmother.
Bring 8 logs back so the town can rebuild.
outro: It is done, then. They will sing about this in every tavern from here to the coast.
Take your reward. You have more than earned it.

lines: player: What do you know of Frostbite Cavern?
Only that those who go in come back thin and quiet. The Broodmother rules it now.
player: Word from Velneir: The Broodmother is dead.
Dead? Then the caravans can leave at dawn. This news is worth more than gold.
